758:t_1:139.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Is $$アルト$$ flying around in his $$ＥＸ－ギア$$ again?」

758:t_1:140.en:
$$シェリル$$
「He is. He said he really loves this new planet's sky.」

758:t_1:141.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「He's using the reconnaissance mission as an excuse to do whatever he wants.」

758:t_1:142.en:
$$クラン$$
「Well, that's fine. Today's mission is called a survey, but it's practically a picnic.」

758:t_1:143.en:
$$カナリア$$
「That's right. That's why we're allowed to bring family and sweethearts along.」

758:t_1:144.en:
$$ナナセ$$
「Thank you for inviting me too, $$ルカ$$.」

758:t_1:145.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Of course I invited you, $$ナナセ$$. After all...」

758:t_1:146.en:
$$ナナセ$$
「I'm so happy I can be with $$ランカ$$ even on my day off!」

758:t_1:148.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Still, Ensign $$アルト$$'s love of the sky is a little abnormal when it goes that far.」

758:t_1:149.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Not really. Everyone wants to fly to their heart's content in an unfamiliar sky.」

758:t_1:150.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That frontier spirit has kept us moving forward.」

758:t_1:151.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...You're right. And those fearless feelings helped us understand the $$バジュラ$$ too.」

758:t_1:152.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But as deputy commander of $$スカル小隊$$, I can't keep overlooking it.」

758:t_1:153.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Watching $$アルト$$ has made you itch to get out there too, hasn't it, $$ブレラ$$?」

758:t_1:155.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Go on, my brother! Take that cocky $$アルト$$ down a peg!」

758:t_1:156.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ returns to Earth tomorrow! Until then, enjoy our new home to the fullest!」

758:t_1:158.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$... So the commander sent him after me...」

758:t_1:159.en:
$$アルト$$
「But don't think you can stop me now!」

758:t_1:161.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're a $$バジュラ$$ larva...! Have you returned to the planet where you were born?」

758:t_1:162.en:
$$アルト$$
「It looks like we'll live together with the $$バジュラ$$ sooner than I thought.」

758:t_1:163.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'll fly through this sky... unbound by anything, however I please...)

758:t_1:164.en:
$$アルト$$
(But I'm not alone... $$ランカ$$... I'll always return to you.)

758:t_1:165.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$... So the commander sent him after me...」

758:t_1:166.en:
$$アルト$$
「But don't think you can stop me now!」

758:t_1:168.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're a $$バジュラ$$ larva...! Have you returned to the planet where you were born?」

758:t_1:169.en:
$$アルト$$
「It looks like we'll live together with the $$バジュラ$$ sooner than I thought.」

758:t_1:170.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'll fly through this sky... unbound by anything, however I please...)

758:t_1:171.en:
$$アルト$$
(But I'm not alone... $$シェリル$$... I'll always return to you.)

758:t_1:175.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Well, everyone. Thank you for all your hard work up to today.」

758:t_1:178.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Your contracts kept getting extended informally, but $$チームＤ$$ officially disbands today.」

758:t_1:182.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We'll pay you your contract completion bonuses and give you all the support we can as you return to civilian life.」

758:t_1:183.en:
$$田中司令$$
「And as a special exception, we won't erase your memories! Isn't that wonderful!」

758:t_1:185.en:
$$葵$$
「Could we keep $$チームＤ$$ going as we are?」

758:t_1:186.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Even if you ask that, the fighting is over, and $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s role...」

758:t_1:188.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Did you forget $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s original role?」

758:t_1:189.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Its role is to preserve species and spread them across the universe.」

758:t_1:190.en:
$$田中司令$$
「But that was... insurance in case Earth perished...」

758:t_1:191.en:
$$葵$$
「That doesn't matter. We've got this hyperdimensional world now. Don't you think traveling to all sorts of worlds sounds good?」

758:t_1:192.en:
$$くらら$$
「I think visiting everyone's worlds in $c, or going to $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s home, would be nice.」

758:t_1:193.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It's true that $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ was planning to pass through the gate and head to the universe where I was born, but...」

758:t_1:194.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「Are you saying you'll go along too?」

758:t_1:196.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「You won't find many ventures more rewarding in this new world.」

758:t_1:197.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Just thinking about it is exciting!」

758:t_1:199.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't go back on my word.」

758:t_1:200.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then we'll renew our contract with $$チームＤ$$... And I give you this order...」

758:t_1:201.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Spread your wings in this new world with $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$!」

758:t_1:203.en:
$$葵$$
(Senpai, everyone... I'm sure we'll... see each other again...)

758:t_1:208.en:
$$シリウス$$
「What we can see over there is... the $$エレメントスクール$$...!」

758:t_1:209.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We're... back in our original world...」

758:t_1:210.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Then we can see everyone again!」

758:t_1:211.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You look happy, $$シルヴィア$$.」

758:t_1:213.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「But the happiest part of that fighting was getting to see you, $$アポロ$$, and my brother.」

758:t_1:216.en:
$$シリウス$$
(Heh... My sister, $$シルヴィア$$... You no longer need my help.)

758:t_1:217.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go, $$シルヴィア$$, $$シリウス$$. This is the world we're going to live in!」

758:t_1:218.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And let's keep expanding it so we can see those guys again too!」

758:t_1:219.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
(After 12,000 years, this is the world where I'll live with the one I love... This is it...)

758:t_1:225.en:
$$ドナール$$
「Welcome back, all of you!」
